responsibility: Definitions of tree indices and attribute tags used to label Objective-C metadata for NeXT/Darwin-style runtimes. It centralizes the objc_rt_trees slots and symbolic macros for metadata kinds such as class, metaclass, methods, protocols, selectors, class references, property lists, exception types, and strings so that runtime emitters and the backend can preserve these distinctions through LTO and place metadata into the correct target-specific sections.
